estimator.name: tail_Polyak_Ruppert_average
estimator.mixing_information: exact public task kernel certificate; unrestricted unknown mixing remains forbidden by T-017

analysis.risk: T-044 exact scalar tail-PR finite-horizon risk

mandatory_gates.M1: both inherited public task kernels and exact projected-TD constants are valid and unchanged
mandatory_gates.M2: all 1728 registered rows are finite, stable, and have a nonempty PR averaging window
mandatory_gates.M3: under rho=0 message binding, q=16 improves risk over q=1 by at least 5 percent in at least 80 percent of cells
mandatory_gates.M4: under rho=1 message binding, q=1 is optimal in at least 90 percent of cells
mandatory_gates.M5: under rho=1 environment binding, oracle participation value over q=1 is at most 1 percent in every cell
mandatory_gates.M6: best-q support contains q=1 and q=16 for each task
mandatory_gates.M7: message-cell oracle versus strongest fixed-q aggregate geometric improvement is at least 5 percent
mandatory_gates.M8: the message-cell oracle strictly improves at least 40 percent of cells
mandatory_gates.M9: no T-043A result row, sampled trajectory, seed, confidence interval, pilot, formal run, or GPU job is used
mandatory_gates.M10: a clean rerun is byte-identical and all configuration, runner, core, task-kernel, rows, and summary hashes are recorded

stop_rule: This is the final standard-task feasibility attempt. Any failed mandatory gate forbids EXP-020B and stops further standard-task redesign under the ICML mainline.
